text: My love, I have been thinking about you all day. The ship's supply payment failed and they won't let me leave the rig until the customs fee is paid. It is only $3,800 and I will repay you the moment I land in Houston. You are the only one I trust. Please don't tell your children, they would not understand us.
notes: Long-distance romance: offshore-worker story, money for fees, isolation from family.
